name: Neverwinter Nights Diamond
description: Neverwinter Nights Diamond is a singleplayer and multiplayer third-person role-playing game.

gog.store_details: This is the original 2002 Neverwinter Nights with both expansions and the premium modules. GOG stopped selling it on its own in October 2018 (per GOG's forums), but it's still an ideal candidate for restoring EAX sound.

audio_settings.title: Enable EAX
audio_settings.reason: Automatically enables EAX in Neverwinter Nights' configuration.

audio_settings.title: Enable stereo sound
audio_settings.reason: Sets Neverwinter Nights' mixer to stereo sound.

audio_settings.title: Enable 4.0 surround sound
audio_settings.reason: Sets Neverwinter Nights' mixer to 4.0 surround sound.

audio_settings.title: Enable 5.1 surround sound
audio_settings.reason: Sets Neverwinter Nights' mixer to 5.1 surround sound.

audio_settings.title: Enable 7.1 surround sound
audio_settings.reason: Sets Neverwinter Nights' mixer to 7.1 surround sound.

audio_settings.title: Enable Pro Logic surround sound
audio_settings.reason: Sets Neverwinter Nights' mixer to Pro Logic surround sound.
audio_settings.follow_up: Don't forget to set your AV receiver or Soundbar to Dolby Pro Logic.

audio_settings.title: Enable headphones
audio_settings.reason: Sets Neverwinter Nights' mixer to headphones.

sources.title: GOG: Neverwinter Nights: Enhanced Edition release post
